messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered: inference-gateway — High 5xx error rate (prod-usw2). Condition: 5xx_rate > 4.5% over 2m. PD: INC-554322. Paging @Olivia (oncall).
Olivia (oncall): Ack'd. I'm on it. Checking dashboards now :eyes:
Olivia (oncall): Anyone else online who can help triage? @Jim? @Raj?
Jim (eng-sre): here, looking. Can you paste the runbook link? I'll start a tail of 503s on the gateway pods.
Olivia (oncall): Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/gateway-5xx. Starting `kubectl -n prod get pods` and `kubectl -n prod logs -f` on a few ingress replicas.
Raj (platform): Noticed a small canary push 7m ago to edge-proxy. I'm checking rollout state. `kubectl rollout status deployment/edge-proxy -n prod` shows some pods restarting.
Jim (eng-sre): I'm seeing repeated upstream 502->503 chain in the logs. Snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:12:03Z ingress[edge-3] ERROR upstream response 502 id=abcd status=502 latency=120ms
2026-03-15T02:12:04Z ingress[edge-3] ERROR upstream response 503 id=abce status=503 reason=kv-cache-miss
```
Olivia (oncall): CX alert coming in — Maya, any customer impact reports?
Maya (customer-success): A handful of enterprise customers in USW2 reported slow responses and 502s starting ~02:11 UTC. No data exfiltration concerns so far. They're asking for ETA.
Raj (platform): Canary looks like it rolled a new build with an experimental header-hq optimization. I'm going to pause the rollout and scale down canary replicas: `kubectl patch deployment/edge-proxy -p '{"spec": {"replicas": 1}}'`.
Olivia (oncall): Doing a quick mitigation: enable fallback rate-limiter to reduce burst traffic to backends. Running infra play: `infra-bot run enable-backend-splay --service inference-gateway --region usw2`.
infra-bot: Command accepted. Starting splay job. ETA ~60s.
Jim (eng-sre): While that's running, we should flip traffic to a healthy variant. Raj, can we route a slice to prod-usw3 backup? If yes, we'll reroute 20% to reduce backend pressure.
Raj (platform): We can. Executing traffic-move: `trafficctl shift --from usw2 --to usw3 --percent 20 --service inference-gateway`.
Olivia (oncall): PD note: Acknowledged by Olivia at 02:14. Escalation to SRE lead if not mitigated by 02:21.
Maya (customer-success): Let me DM the affected customers with a short note: investigating elevated 5xx in USW2, mitigation in progress, will update in 15m.
Jim (eng-sre): After splay + 20% reroute, error rate dropped from 6.2% -> 2.1% in graphs. Looks promising. Continuing to monitor.
Olivia (oncall): Great. Keep an eye for any regressions. Can we roll back the canary entirely? Raj?
Raj (platform): Initiating rollback: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/edge-proxy -n prod --to-revision=42`. Rolling back canary now.
Olivia (oncall): Noting timeline in PD: initial page 02:12, mitigations applied 02:15-02:17.
Jim (eng-sre): Logs after rollback: upstream 200/3xx dominant, occasional isolated 502s but within normal. I'm going to open a post-incident issue to root cause the header-hq optimization interaction with kv-cache.
Maya (customer-success): Sending follow-up to customers: "We applied a rollback and traffic-shift; service is recovering. We'll share a full incident summary soon." :white_check_mark:
infra-bot: splay job completed successfully.
Raj (platform): Traffic shift completed, percent moved 20%. Monitoring shows stable CPU on backend and reduced error spikes.
Olivia (oncall): Error rate is back down to 0.9% for the last 5m. PD: adding note and resolving alert if stable for 10m.
Jim (eng-sre): Filing INC-554322 follow-up: root cause hypothesis — canary introduced header behavior that increased cache churn and triggered backend overload. Next steps: replay, canary diff, stronger circuit-breaker.
Olivia (oncall): Closing paging loop. Thanks all — excellent quick coordination. Will schedule postmortem and notify stakeholders.
incident-bot: PD incident INC-554322 status: resolved by Olivia at 02:26 UTC. Follow-up: https://redwood.incidents/INC-554322
Maya (customer-success): Posted customer updates and created a support ticket batch for affected accounts.
Olivia (oncall): final check: anyone see lingering alerts? If not, I'll mark this thread resolved in 10m.
Jim (eng-sre): All quiet here. No more 5xx spike. Marking as stable.
Olivia (oncall): resolving thread. Thanks everyone!
